hints: Write the general term of $(x + 3x^{-2})^6$: $\binom{6}{r} x^{6-r} (3x^{-2})^r = \binom{6}{r} 3^r x^{6-3r}$.
walkthrough:
Express the general term in the binomial expansion of $(x + 3x^{-2})^6$:
$$T_{r+1} = \binom{6}{r} (x)^{6-r} \left(\frac{3}{x^2}\right)^r = \binom{6}{r} 3^r x^{6-3r}$$

Find the value of $r$ that gives the term independent of $x$ ($x^0$):
$$6 - 3r = 0 \implies 3r = 6 \implies r = 2$$

Calculate the term independent of $x$:
$$\text{Constant term} = \binom{6}{2} 3^2 = 15 \times 9 = 135$$

hints: The constant term in $(4x^3-5)(x+3/x^2)^6$ comes from $4x^3 \times (x^{-3} \text{ term})$ and $-5 \times (\text{constant term})$.
Find the $x^{-3}$ term in $(x+3/x^2)^6$ by setting $6-3r = -3 \implies r = 3$.
walkthrough:
Find the $x^{-3}$ term in the expansion of $(x + 3x^{-2})^6$:
$$6 - 3r = -3 \implies 3r = 9 \implies r = 3$$
$$\text{Term in } x^{-3} = \binom{6}{3}(x)^3\left(\frac{3}{x^2}\right)^3 = 20 \times 27 x^{-3} = 540x^{-3}$$

Identify the products that produce a term independent of $x$ when multiplying by $(4x^3 - 5)$:
$$\text{From } 4x^3 \times (540x^{-3}) = 2160$$
$$\text{From } -5 \times 135 = -675$$

Sum the components to find the total term independent of $x$:
$$\text{Term independent of } x = 2160 - 675 = 1485$$
